question: Which of the following can be referred to in the estimation of poverty?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Monthly Per Capita Expenditure.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__ **

__
 
• **Monthly Per Capita Expenditure:-**

 
 
• 
 
It is used in economics and personal finance to describe the average monthly spending of each person in a defined population, such as a household, city, province, or country.

 
 
• 
 
This is calculated by taking the total monthly expenditure of the population and dividing it by the total number of people in that population.

 
 
• 
 
Formula:- **Monthly Per Capita Expenditure = Total monthly expenditure / Total population**.

 
 
• 
 
It can be referred to in the estimation of poverty.

 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Marginal utility:-**

 
 
• It refers to the additional satisfaction or benefit (utility) that a consumer derives from consuming an additional unit of a good or service.
 
• The principle of diminishing marginal utility suggests that as a person consumes more and more of a good, the incremental benefit experienced from consuming another unit declines.
 
 
 
• **Minimum Support Price:-**
 
 
• It is generally used in the context of agricultural policies.
 
• MSP is a form of market intervention by the government to insure agricultural producers against any sharp fall in farm prices.
 
• The minimum support prices are announced by the government at the beginning of the sowing season for certain crops.
